category_title: Autistic students who partially process problems with discrepancy gestures and echolalia
scenario_title: Identifying geometric shapes with multiple visual distractors
minimal_context: Rico is working on a task sheet to identify and mark images of concrete objects shaped like a beam and a ball.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at this task sheet. Find the images shaped like a beam and a ball, and put a checkmark next to them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Focuses on the objects with irregular hand movements. He moves his hand as if about to put a checkmark on the pencil and cap, but hesitates and turns his attention to the tissue box) Tissue... tissue...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep looking at the pictures. Which one is the beam?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (His view slowly turns, observing the variety of objects. He makes a discrepancy gesture, pointing his finger at the image of the cap while looking at the beam)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What about the ball? Can you find the ball?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (He ignores the image of the marbles. His hand movements give a checkmark on the picture of the hat instead. He stares at the canned milk and repeats quickly) Canned milk, canned milk.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please look at this task sheet. Find the images shaped like a beam and a ball, and put a checkmark next to them.

STUDENT: (Focuses on the objects with irregular hand movements. He moves his hand as if about to put a checkmark on the pencil and cap, but hesitates and turns his attention to the tissue box) Tissue... tissue...

TUTOR: Keep looking at the pictures. Which one is the beam?

STUDENT: (His view slowly turns, observing the variety of objects. He makes a discrepancy gesture, pointing his finger at the image of the cap while looking at the beam)

TUTOR: What about the ball? Can you find the ball?

STUDENT: (He ignores the image of the marbles. His hand movements give a checkmark on the picture of the hat instead. He stares at the canned milk and repeats quickly) Canned milk, canned milk.

task.content: Identifying the shape of a 'beam' and 'ball' on a task sheet using images of concrete objects
task.learning_goal: Identify appropriate concrete objects specified geometry

context.materials: Task sheet with images of concrete objects including a pencil, cap, tissue box, marbles, hat, and canned milk, as well as concrete objects such as dice and cardboard
context.social_setting: Teacher guiding students working on task

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When attempting to identify the picture 'beam' or 'ball' among multiple images
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Hesitated, turned his attention to observe the image 'Tissue' in the picture 'cap', discrepancy gesture pointing to an image 'cap' on the 'beam', hand movements still give a '√' in the picture 'hat' again, ignored the image 'marbles'
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Distracted on spatial relations, difficulty repeating ideas visually perceived image, distraction on observation to perceive the form

behavior_patterns.condition: When observing a variety of objects that are interrelated
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Facial expressions focus to hold objects observation with irregular hand movements move, view slowly turns observing a variety of objects but difficult to maintain his observations
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Difficulty selecting or process information so that individual processing of sensory information by partially corrects
